metaTitle: How a Campground WiFi Extender Works
description: Learn how a campground WiFi extender or WiFi-as-WAN booster captures a distant signal, how antenna height and bands matter, and what speeds to expect in an RV.
directAnswer: A campground WiFi extender uses a high-gain outdoor antenna to catch a weak signal and feeds a router that makes your own network. It stabilizes a weak link but cannot speed up an overloaded campground connection.
